skills.name: nibgate-agent-discovery
skills.description: Discover, unlock, and read Nibgate paid content as an AI agent. Covers the Explore feed, public ledger (including pending funded tip holds and negative refund entries), public exact-domain pending-tip checks for any site, nibshare links, creator-site access endpoints, Nib Tips (settled for known creators, held + refundable for external/unclaimed ones), and paying over x402 with the Circle Agent Stack CLI or raw Circle Gateway. Includes mainnet and testnet proof-versus-confirmation semantics and safe verification retry/reconciliation guidance. Documents hosted checkout versus server-side access enforcement and the held-tip owner/keeper authorization boundary.

skills.name: nibgate-sdk

Includes mainnet and testnet proof-versus-confirmation semantics and safe verification retry/reconciliation guidance. Documents hosted checkout versus server-side access enforcement and the held-tip owner/keeper authorization boundary.
